name: VaniTea Café
notes: own site has separate Chula Vista vs Rancho San Diego menu pages; the router's Clover hit was the wrong (Chula Vista/Telegraph Canyon) branch. Used the dedicated 'Menu – Rancho San Diego' page's photographed menu instead, which matches our work-list area (Jamacha Road / Rancho San Diego) though the photo itself does not print a street address. Photo is dated 2023-02, so prices may have drifted; the site had no more recent menu photo. Bubble-tea categories (Snow Bubble, Milk Tea, Tea, Slushies) are flat-priced per category regardless of flavor — recorded once per category rather than once per flavor to avoid a wall of duplicate-priced rows; the full flavor lists are in each item's description. Marked +$/exception items (Ice Cream/Vanilla Chai Milk Tea +$0.50, Chamango/Flavored Red Bull Slushie $6.50) are noted, not added arithmetically.
